Task Guide:

Task: Organic Compound Elucidation
Description

The purity of the compound (99%) was determined by quantitative 1H NMR analysis using 1,1,2,2-tetrachloroethane as an internal standard. The ee (> 99%) was determined by HPLC analysis with an Agilent 1100 Series HPLC system equipped with a CHIRALPAK OD-H column (length 250 mm, I.D. 4.6 mm) (hexanes/2-propanol 90:10, 1.0 mL/min) with tr (major) = 6.3 min, tr (minor) = 7.7 min. The peak areas were measured at λ = 230 nm.. Return only the SMILES without any additional text.

- answer: smiles_or_name_of_the_compound
